["if", flag, [steps]]  (flag may start with ! to mean NOT)   ["pick", [[steps], [steps], ...]] picks one per day

Words in {braces} are filled from your campaign: {weekday} {date} {ySummary} {yGround} {yLost} {caps} {lostTown}

prologue.title: The Long Peace
steps: The Heartland won its last war three hundred years ago.
The banners came down. The walls grew moss. Peace was earned, and then, slowly, it was spent.
A soldier learned he could live a whole life and never once be tested. Most chose to.
They called it contentment. The old generals had another name for it.
It does not burn cities. It empties them.
A garrison that no longer drills. A scholar who stops at good enough. A knight who never draws his sword again, and calls it wisdom.
Out past the marshes it grew bold. Province by province, the lamps went out.
We will wait. There is always more time.
One officer did not. Not the strongest. Not the most gifted. Only the one who remembers what it felt like to be hungry.
They will tell you basic is enough. For some it is. Their basic already sits near the summit.
Every question is ground. Every card is a soldier who remembers. Every day you wait, the Hollowing takes a little more.
So take it back. Town by town. Province by province. Until the shelf.

muster.title: The Muster
steps: The first dawn of the campaign. {towns} of 79 towns fly your banner.
Nothing is owed to us. Everything out there must be taken.
The line held yesterday. {ySummary}. {yGround} ground taken.
The Hollowing does not need to defeat you. It only needs you to wait.
The walls are still under siege. {due} cards at the gates.
{ankiGoal} reviews today keeps us on course to break it by {clearBy}.
The siege is broken. The supply lines run again.
An enemy column marches on {attackTown}. Your first {defenseQ} questions decide it.
Comfort is not the enemy. Staying comfortable is.
Good enough is a place people go to stop.
The honors line is {targetPct}%. It was always reachable. The question is whether you march.
No one remembers the days you rested. They remember what you built.
Basic is fine, if your basic is the summit. Yours is not, yet.
{daysToShelf} days to the shelf. Each one is a choice.
Existing is easy. Anyone can exist. You came here to become.
Three points. Ten points. That is the width of a few hundred questions.
The version of you that honors IM is built today, not on the eve of the exam.
Hunger fades if you feed it nothing. Feed it ground.
